events.title: BAD STUDENT LOVE | Steam Next Fest Demo Gameplay Showcase (Pre-recorded)
events.summary: Welcome to BAD STUDENT LOVE!Watch gameplay footage from our demo and get a glimpse of the characters, story, and choices awaiting you at Hando High School.Download and play the free demo during Steam Next Fest, and don't forget to add BAD STUDENT LOVE to your wishlist!Please note: This broadcast features pre-recorded gameplay footage played on a continuous loop.
